title: Learning consequences threshold
statement: Let $t>0$ be a rational influence bound and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter. The learning consequences threshold is the internal error associated with $\varepsilon$, squared and divided by $t^2$, multiplied by $(1/9)^d$, where $d$ is the learning consequences degree for $t$ and $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the internal error associated with $\varepsilon$ or give an independent description of the degree.
